corrections: Guard identical hidden/inert writes so context change observation cannot cause a repeated update cycle.
Use explicit previous/next constructor input instead of accessing an abstract property during construction.
WebKit pointer clicks follow its bare native button focus behavior. Keyboard completion focus passes in all engines; no pointer-focus workaround is added.
Run site generation before the full suite; an earlier run failed only because its two new pages were not generated yet.
limits: Actual Safari and assistive-technology interaction remain M22/M26.
Final React wrappers and scoped-registry acceptance remain M22.
M15 still requires Toolbar/App Bar/Breadcrumbs and Command Menu, with Dialog brought forward from M17.
